festivals.what: Karatsu Kunchi (Karatsu Shrine): every year on 2, 3 and 4 November; the evening float procession on the 2nd, the procession to the Nishinohama otabisho (resting place) on the 3rd and the town round on the 4th, with the hikiyama floats. There are no paid seats.

sources.title: 唐津くんち
sources.supports: 2 to 4 November, sequence, viewing rules (read directly 2026-11-05)

culture-cycles.note: Dates from the shrine, city or tourism body's own page, read directly 2026-11-05.

culture-and-protocol.dress_and_conduct: During Karatsu Kunchi the tourism association asks viewers to follow police and float crews, keep clear of the floats and their ropes, not walk beside or close behind them, stand back at corners, not sit on the road or step onto the route, and not use selfie sticks; drones are not allowed over the route or near the shrine.
culture-and-protocol.cultural_authority: Karatsu Shrine and the float-holding town groups.

laws.rule: Saga City has designated the area around Saga Station as a street-smoking prohibited district (路上喫煙禁止地区). The city asks people not to smoke on the street there even when nobody is nearby. The city's page states no fine.
laws.heading: 佐賀市 路上喫煙禁止地区

laws.rule: Saga Youth Healthy Development Ordinance (佐賀県青少年健全育成条例), art. 20. The ordinance sets the late-night period as 11 pm to 4 am. A guardian must try not to let a young person (generally under 18) go out in that period without special reason; the guardian's own duty has no penalty. Anyone else is barred from taking such a young person out, going about with them or keeping them out in that period without the guardian's consent or another proper reason. The offence for others carries a fine of up to JPY 100,000 (about A$902) or a petty fine (kayo). Rates: RBA 30 Oct 2026, A$1 = JPY 110.82.
laws.heading: 佐賀県青少年健全育成条例 (Saga), curfew for young people
